picks.what: Aerial photograph during the bombing of the Pont aux Lions

gaps: P0–P3: none (#1 is a portrait of King Hugh of Arles, not a view); P6: no modern photo of the town (#9–#12 are photos of a Van Gogh painting)
notes: Van Gogh’s views of Arles (#7 1888 with irises, #4/#6 1889 orchards) are real views but show the town only as a thin strip on the horizon; #7 could replace the photochrom if a general view is preferred over the arena. #8 is low resolution (911 px wide) and shows bomb smoke on the river; the focal point puts the intact old town and arena in the 16:9 crop. Drop it if a wartime photo is unwanted as the only 20th-century image.
